_doc: Reviewed exceptions to audit-we-historical-season.js's in-window check: a review dated outside its show's run window that a session checked and kept. One entry per review (showId + outletId + publishDate), with the evidence. Add an entry only after reading the review; a review of a different production gets wrongProduction instead.

exceptions.reason: Second lockdown closed the NT Olivier run on its press night (4 Nov 2020). The review covers the filmed press-night performance of this staging ("Because the press night performance was filmed"), so it is this production, published 23 days after close.
